span.p:
All transitions shown are built.
Checkout failures never create an order: 400 invalid / unknown payment method,
402 declined, 409 out of stock, 503 upstream down (any reservation is released).
PaymentCaptured/PaymentFailed are accepted from authorized or dispatched.
